mapper.sql: p.id, p.shop_code, p.purchasecode as purchase_code, p.partnercode as partner_code, p.partnername as partner_name, p.goodssummary as goods_summary, p.purchasedate as purchase_date, p.expectdate as expect_date, p.totalamount as total_amount, p.freighttype as freight_type, p.estimatedfreight as estimated_freight, p.actualfreight as actual_freight, p.paidamount as paid_amount, p.paystatus as pay_status, p.logisticsno as logistics_no, p.carrier, p.confirmuser as confirm_user, p.confirmtime as confirm_time, p.status, p.rejectreason as reject_reason, p.remark, p.createuser as create_user, p.createtime as create_time, p.updateuser as update_user, p.updatetime as update_time

select , cu.nick_name as create_user_name, fu.nick_name as confirm_user_name from sdsshop.u_p_purchase p left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = p.createuser left join sys_user fu on fu.user_name = p.confirmuser
mapper.select:
where p.shop_code = #{shopCode} and (
p.purchasecode = #{includeCode} or
(p.status not in ('draft', 'cancelled') and (coalesce(p.totalamount, 0) <= 0 or coalesce(p.paidamount, 0) < coalesce(p.totalamount, 0))) ) order by p.createtime desc, p.purchasecode desc
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_p_purchase( shop_code, purchasecode, partnercode, partnername, goodssummary, purchasedate, expectdate, totalamount, freighttype, estimatedfreight, actualfreight, status, remark, createuser, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{purchaseCode}, #{partnerCode}, #{partnerName}, #{goodsSummary}, #{purchaseDate}, #{expectDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{freightType}, coalesce(#{estimatedFreight}, 0), 0, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_p_purchase set partnercode = #{partnerCode}, partnername = #{partnerName}, goodssummary = #{goodsSummary}, purchasedate = #{purchaseDate}, expectdate = #{expectDate}, totalamount = #{totalAmount}, freighttype = #{freightType}, estimatedfreight = coalesce(#{estimatedFreight}, 0), remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where id = #{id} and shop_code = #{shopCode} and status = 'draft'

update sdsshop.u_p_purchase set status = #{status}, rejectreason = #{rejectReason},
confirmuser = #{confirmUser},
confirmtime = #{confirmTime},
updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and purchasecode = #{purchaseCode} and status in
#{expected}

update sdsshop.u_p_purchase set logisticsno = #{logisticsNo}, carrier = #{carrier}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and purchasecode = #{purchaseCode} and status in ('approved', 'partial_received')
